summary: Assist to RMRG with a search for a missing male party in the Gross Reservoir area
notes: Alpine 2016 Missions PDF item 16-06. Search ran 01/22; paged 01/21 Mountain-Ear 2016 year-end roundup corroborates: reported missing Jan 17, 2016 (Eldora employee), vehicle found at Gross Reservoir, helicopter/dog search, never found.
